prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported whiplash. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1416; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the intersection in Pasadena, Texas, I observed two passenger vehicles with front-end and driver-side damage resting in the eastbound lanes. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound and stated that he was proceeding straight through the intersection when a vehicle turning left from the opposite direction crossed into his path. Driver 2 was operating a southbound SUV, was in the process of making a left turn, and stated that she yielded to oncoming traffic but did not see the sedan until contact occurred. A Passenger seated in the rear of the SUV was present at the scene. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash and was evaluated by EMS before declining transport. Both vehicles were driven from the roadway after documentation. Traffic signals were functioning normally at the time of the collision, and no citations were issued pending further review of witness statements.
